g.text: Enterprise Architecture Board (EAB) — Fiduciary Governance Tree
Hierarchical decision domains, stage-gate veto authority, and assigned character personas across the ecosystem
Core Decision Domain: TOGAF ADM Phase Alignment, Ecosystem Transformation, Agnostic Tech Evaluation
Veto Checkpoint: Scope & Architecture Roadmap Deviations, Vendor Lock-in
CapEx Allocation, Unit Economics, TCO (Total Cost of Ownership)
Factory Automation TCO & Cell Yield Value
Edge Feasibility, Robotics, Workforce Change Management
Factory Floor Robotics & Line Assembly Sync
ESG Reporting, EU AI Act, Security, IP Protection
EU AI Act & Battery Model IP Security
🏛️ EAB GOVERNANCE PROTOCOL & UNANIMOUS THREE-SEAT VETO RULE:
1. Unanimous Consent: No project passes Stage-Gates 1–4 without affirmative sign-off from all 3 functional seats (Fiscal, Operational, Risk).
2. Executive Arbitration: Narayan Debnath enforces agnostic evaluation and breaks inter-company deadlocks to prevent vendor capture.
3. 90-Day Variance Escrow: Any non-standard implementation requires a funded Technical Debt Remediation Plan signed by the respective seat.
